name: Cliniaro
subtitle: A clearer day at the clinic.
description: A clinic management product connecting patient records, appointments, prescriptions and everyday operations.
problem: Clinic work crosses many separate touchpoints: scheduling, patient information, prescriptions and billing. The product direction is to bring those workflows into one coherent workspace.
solution: A shared clinic workspace, organized around the patient journey. The interface study below explores how a daily schedule and patient context could sit together.
next: Validate the complete appointment-to-prescription workflow with real clinic users.

name: WhatsCRM
subtitle: Conversations with somewhere to go.
description: A WhatsApp-focused CRM concept for keeping conversations, contacts and lead pipelines connected.
problem: A useful sales conversation can lose its context when contacts, follow-ups and pipeline stages live in different places.
solution: A connected view of conversations and leads, with a visual pipeline for understanding the next action. This interface study uses illustrative data.
next: Clarify integration constraints and test how a conversation becomes an actionable lead.

name: WFH Connect
subtitle: A better starting point for remote work.
description: A platform direction for work-from-home opportunities, training, registration and candidate management.
problem: Candidates need a clear path from discovering an opportunity to understanding its requirements and registering their interest.
solution: An opportunity-first experience connecting discovery, training and candidate registration. The scope and implementation details still need to be documented.
next: Validate opportunity information and simplify the candidate registration journey.

name: Webdivi
subtitle: Small business. Considered presence.
description: A digital presence concept bringing websites, CRM, SEO and analytics together for small businesses.
problem: A small business needs its online presence to support real operations, from being found to responding to a new inquiry.
solution: A connected web solution concept that treats the website, lead workflow and measurement as parts of the same system.
next: Define an initial service scope and validate it with a small-business workflow.
